activation.note: Before activation a recognized hyf_ops_v2 request is parsed and then refused with capability_unavailable; it never reaches the legacy shortcut handlers even when their enable flag is set. C004 does not advertise v2 readiness.

money_binding.note: ADR-0027 D47 BP01: snapshot.price binds the existing scaled money representation (state/amount/scale/currency/basis) distinct from the reported-quantity decimal projection. known requires a canonical nonnegative integer amount, integer scale 0..9, nonblank currency and basis per_unit|per_pack|per_order (zero is known); unknown requires amount/scale/currency null and basis unknown and is never free. Optional closed fees {kind,amount,scale,currency} are the separate money-schema family. Legacy hyf_v1_jev money schema/domain constructors are unchanged; C009 enforces the checked int64 coefficient and typed mapping.

provenance_binding.note: ADR-0027 D47 BP01: every successful output requires a closed provenance object carrying only the immutable identities actually used, independently of optional detailed evidence and context.return_provenance. Error envelopes carry no output/provenance. Identity equality, actual use, uniqueness and coverage/allocation agreement are semantic obligations owned by C009/C023/C030/C038/C041.
